replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Evidence shows public endpoint accepting arbitrary order id/status, enabling forged paid orders."},{"id":"T2","keep":false,"reason":"Same unauthenticated endpoint flaw and harm (unauthorized order status manipulation) as T1.","duplicateOf":"T1"},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Distinct attack vector: replay of captured legitimate events, no idempotency mentioned in evidence."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Distinct harm: volumetric flooding/DoS on order service, not spoofing a single order's status."}]}
